secondary_english_normalized.label: Secondary standard Whisper English-normalized WER; not the primary study metric
secondary_english_normalized.reason: US Whisper emits digits while primary references spell numbers; apply one existing standard normalizer uniformly to all 11 systems. No inference or checkpoint changes.
secondary_english_normalized.warning: This normalizer also changes contractions, fillers, spelling and punctuation; it is not a number-only or ATC identifier-accuracy metric. Denominators differ from primary WER.
secondary_english_normalized.python_compatibility: Evaluated the unmodified Transformers normalizer source with postponed annotation compilation for Python 3.8; no normalization logic changed.

ctc_development_audit.purpose: Development-only independent scalar FP32 check of BF16 batched greedy CTC path

scope: Eight new ATC-specific shortlisted checkpoints; three identity-verified existing baselines. Not inference of every repository in the inventory.
interpretation: Known-Jacktol-disjoint is not proof of independence from other ATCO2-derived training. Offline community inference does not establish native streaming equivalence.
runtime_caveat: Concurrent 8-model node; HF timing excludes model loading, NeMo includes test reload. Not a controlled latency benchmark.
